import bisect

def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    a.sort()
    t = int(input())
    ans = -1
    for i in range(n):
        # Find the upper bound of a[i] + t
        up = bisect.bisect_right(a, a[i] + t)
        ans = max(ans, up - i)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
